INSERT INTO booklist_check_detail ( task_id, book_number, book_name, subtitle, author1, author2, author, isbn, publish_location, publisher, publish_date, target_audience, content_summary, classification_number, language, hit_sensitive, hit_problem_book, is_whitelist_publisher, risk_level, sensitive_words, detection_time, check_status, created_time ) VALUES
( #{item.taskId}, #{item.bookNumber}, #{item.bookName}, #{item.subtitle}, #{item.author1}, #{item.author2}, #{item.author}, #{item.isbn}, #{item.publishLocation}, #{item.publisher}, #{item.publishDate}, #{item.targetAudience}, #{item.contentSummary}, #{item.classificationNumber}, #{item.language}, #{item.hitSensitive}, #{item.hitProblemBook}, #{item.isWhitelistPublisher}, #{item.riskLevel}, #{item.sensitiveWords}, #{item.detectionTime}, #{item.checkStatus}, #{item.createdTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT detail_id, task_id, book_number, book_name, subtitle, author1, author2, author, isbn, publish_location, publisher, publish_date, target_audience, content_summary, classification_number, language, hit_sensitive, hit_problem_book, is_whitelist_publisher, risk_level, sensitive_words, detection_time, check_status, error_message, created_time, updated_time FROM booklist_check_detail WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY detail_id ASC

SELECT detail_id, task_id, book_number, book_name, subtitle, author1, author2, author, isbn, publish_location, publisher, publish_date, target_audience, content_summary, classification_number, language, hit_sensitive, hit_problem_book, is_whitelist_publisher, risk_level, sensitive_words, detection_time, check_status, error_message, created_time, updated_time FROM booklist_check_detail WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY detail_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT detail_id, task_id, book_number, book_name, subtitle, author1, author2, author, isbn, publish_location, publisher, publish_date, target_audience, content_summary, classification_number, language, hit_sensitive, hit_problem_book, is_whitelist_publisher, risk_level, sensitive_words, detection_time, check_status, error_message, created_time, updated_time FROM booklist_check_detail WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND (hit_sensitive = 1 OR hit_problem_book = 1) ORDER BY risk_level DESC, detail_id ASC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN hit_sensitive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sensitive_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN hit_problem_book = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS problem_book_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN is_whitelist_publisher = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_whitelist_pubs FROM booklist_check_detail WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
